name: salawat-bot
description: Telegram bot for a month-long Salawat Challenge among friends during Mawlid month

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/db && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql
scripts.test: tsx --test src/utils/streak.test.ts src/utils/challenge.day.test.ts src/api/adminBroadcast.test.ts src/api/adminUsers.test.ts src/api/indefiniteBeforeWindow.test.ts src/api/indefiniteAfterWindow.test.ts src/api/adminPeriod.test.ts src/api/resetProgress.test.ts src/api/realName.test.ts src/api/fastingReminder.test.ts src/api/registration.pending.test.ts
